notes.title: 🔥 Time Survivors 🔥 is available NOW!
notes.content:
Time Survivors is a bullet heaven \ horde survival indie game that offers a unique blend of action, creatively(?) reimagined history, and roguelike mechanics. As you step into the shoes of historic heroes, each with their unique abilities, you'll traverse battles across various eras while exploring our deep meta-progression system.

Time Survivors is officially live on Steam! 🚀
Grab it now and save 20% to upgrade to the full version of Time Survivors: Chapter 0!
Your savegame will be automatically imported

We've poured 14 months of passion and hard work into this game, and we're thrilled to finally share it with you.

🔥 A bullet heaven game with a twist
🔥 Distinct abilities for each character, making every run unique
🔥 Hordes of enemies, challenging quests, secrets, and epic boss fights
🔥 Customize your characters' growth with our meta progression system

[previewyoutube=GDFq1sCPeq4;full][/previewyoutube]

Leave a Review
We have a small favor to ask: after playing Time Survivors for a bit, could you drop a Steam review? 
Steam reviews are crucial for a game's success. More reviews mean greater visibility, leading to more players seeing our game and enabling us to better support it.

Your honest feedback, good or bad, really helps us gain visibility and improve. It means a lot to our tiny team, and you can always update your review later. Thanks a lot!

notes.title: 🍄 Time Survivors: Release Date Announcement 🍄
notes.content:
Hey fellow gamers,
We're just weeks away from a big day for us – the launch of Time Survivors on January 15, 2024.

Mark Your Calendars: January 15th, 2024!

The past 13 months have been a wild ride of coding marathons, intense playtests, and lively discussions – all fueled by our passion as a three-person indie team.

Time Survivors is more than a game; it's our heart and soul poured into pixels. We're thrilled to share it with you on Windows PC for $4.99. Plus, as a thank you to our early supporters, enjoy a 20% off launch discount.

[previewyoutube=jScUZqv9Flc;full][/previewyoutube]A glimpse of the new Ice Age stage - still WiP! Can you spot the character - a troubled painter with a cap?

Get ready for a content-rich experience: 5 stages, 12 historical characters with unique skills, 93 different enemies, 50+ weapons and items, along with Cursed Relics, unlockables, and hidden gems to uncover.

Time Survivors demo and Chapter 0 players: your progress will carry over to the full game – pick up right where you left off!

We've poured our hearts into Time Survivors, hoping to give you a game that's both challenging and a blast to play. We can’t wait for you to dive into the different eras, unravel the story, and maybe even find yourself attached to our quirky cast of characters.

So don't forget to wishlist Time Survivors and follow us

Cheers,

notes.title: 👾 The Egypt Age, a nostalgic stage in Time Survivors demo 👾
notes.content:
Greetings, Time Survivors,

We're back with a surprise we've been crafting for the past few weeks: a new stage for Time Survivors demo, the Egypt Age. What makes this stage unique is that it plays as side-scrolling shooter!

If you haven't done yet, it's time to get Time Survivors demo

[previewyoutube=rQVfhqKQw2A;full][/previewyoutube]It's a bird! It's a plane! No, it's Nikola Tesla soaring over the sands of Ancient Egypt, battling mummies and Space Invaders

As devoted players of classic games, we wanted to pay homage to the horizontal shooters from the '80s.

👾 So we've added mummies, giant scarabs, scorpions, but also pixelated aliens shooting at you

🎮 We've aimed to blend the "bullet heaven" and "bullet hell" genres in this stage, taking a risk to bring you a nostalgia-infused gaming session that we hope you'll enjoy!

[spoiler]If you get the feeling that something ancient is watching over all: well, you're right. Get to the end of the stage and you will see 👁️[/spoiler] 

PATCH NOTES 0.811
[Gameplay changes]

 New Egypt Age SSS (side-scrolling shooter) stage
 Golden Pests: reduced damage and health

[QoL]

 Support for Russian language
 Dead enemy bodies disappear faster
 Fixed: Damascus Statues colliders for all stages are misaligned
 No unbox dialog if the box only contains gold
 Many other minor fixes


Play the new Egypt Age stage now,  available exclusively in Time Survivors demo
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2211390/Time_Survivors/

Explore the Egypt Age in the Time Survivors demo. Together, we'll make (inaccurate) history, one pixel at a time!

notes.title: 🍄 "Chapter 0" vs 🍄 "Prologue" vs 🍄 "Time Survivors"?
notes.content:
If you played our game "Time Survivors: Prologue", the forthcoming "Time Survivors: Chapter 0" may sound confusing. With this post everything will be much clearer! It's quite simple actually...

Time Survivors: Prologue marked the initial free release of our game. It offered a limited selection of characters and features, and it won't receive further updates. It's likely being removed from Steam in the future.

Time Survivors:  Chapter 0 is the evolution of our free game, inspired by the invaluable feedback from our players who experienced the "Prologue". We've diligently worked to implement significant enhancements, introducing fresh gameplay mechanics. These include unique activable abilities for our historical heroes and a skill-tree meta progression system, allowing you to unlock and refine various gameplay elements.

Time Survivors represents the full game. A free demo will be available at the end of September, and it will be featured at the Steam Next Fest in October. The official launch is scheduled by the end of 2023 and promises a wealth of additional content compared to "Chapter 0". Expect more stages, historical characters with distinctive abilities, items, weapons, and much more.

TL;DR

 "Time Survivors: Prologue": no more updates; switch to "Time Survivors: Chapter 0" (free-to-play!)
 "Time Survivors: Chapter 0": a separate new game, introducing new content and gameplay mechanics. If you played the "Prologue", your progress will transition to "Chapter 0"
 "Time Survivors": the full game with more content than "Chapter 0". Featured at Steam Next Fest in October, full release by year-end. Your "Chapter 0" save game will continue in "Time Survivors"


Join our Discord server if you want to know more or have any questions!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2455500/Time_Survivors_Chapter_0/
